clue.text: Contribute usefully in literary heroine's part?

parts.note: Lorna Doone is the heroine of R. D. Blackmore's novel, so her possessive gives DOONE'S
a bit is a part or piece of something

explanation.surface: A reader wonders about a role played in the story of a famous heroine of fiction.
explanation.walkthrough: Lorna Doone is the heroine of Blackmore's 1869 novel set on Exmoor. 'Doone's bit' read as a phrase splits into the idiom.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to play one's own share in a shared effort, helping usefully.

clue.text: Extremely debatable, my colour scheme

indicators.note: taking the word at its extremes means only its first and last letters are kept

parts.note: cor and my are both exclamations of surprise

explanation.surface: Someone exclaims that their colour scheme is highly controversial.
explanation.definitionFit: Decor is the furnishing and colouring style of a room, its overall colour scheme.

clue.text: Authoritative statements, so clear when translated

indicators.note: translating turns words into another form, so these letters are rendered in a new order

explanation.surface: Official pronouncements become clear once rendered into another language.
explanation.definitionFit: Pronouncements from an oracle are utterances taken as beyond question, hence authoritative statements.

clue.text: Colour that is raised on blue quilt

indicators.note: in a down clue, raising something puts it upwards, so these letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: red is a colour
i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is
feeling blue is feeling down

explanation.surface: A quilt whose colour has been made brighter on a blue background.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blue' looks like a second colour beside the first, but it is the mood word for the last part; 'raised' turns the first two pieces upward, giving EIDER.
explanation.definitionFit: An eiderdown is a thick bed covering stuffed with feathers, a type of quilt.

clue.text: Egghead, having drinks with her, failing to get hard riddle

parts.note: an egghead is an intellectual, a brain
teas are drinks

indicators.note: the word her fails to get, so loses, the letter for hard

parts.note: H is the pencil abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: An intellectual, out drinking with a woman, cannot solve a difficult puzzle.
explanation.definitionFit: A brainteaser is a puzzle or problem that tests ingenuity, much like a riddle.

clue.text: Draw level, almost

indicators.note: almost the whole word means its final letter is dropped

parts.note: a tier is a level or layer

explanation.surface: A sketch drawn very nearly level.
explanation.definitionFit: A drawn game, with neither side winning, is called a tie.

clue.text: Brandish one in joint

indicators.note: one piece is placed in the other

parts.note: a weld is a joint made by fusing metal
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone waves a single item about inside a joint.
explanation.definitionFit: To brandish a weapon is to wave it about, to handle and flourish it.

clue.text: Bet earnings on first in race

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece sits on top of the next

parts.note: a wage is earnings

indicators.note: the first letter of the following word is taken

explanation.surface: A gambler stakes their pay on the leader in a horse race.
explanation.definitionFit: A wager is a stake placed on an outcome, synonymous with a bet.

clue.text: Feeling demonstrated by symbol Charlie left out

indicators.note: the letter for Charlie is omitted from the word

parts.note: an emoticon is a symbol made of keyboard characters showing a mood
C is Charlie in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A man named Charlie feels excluded, and that is shown by a sign.
explanation.definitionFit: An emotion is a feeling such as joy or anger.

clue.text: Diane with actor Ben, one producing drink

parts.note: Di is short for Diane
Ben Stiller is an American actor

explanation.surface: A woman and a Hollywood star together making liquor.
explanation.definitionFit: A distiller makes spirits such as whisky or gin by distillation.

clue.text: Female spies receiving praise

indicators.note: one piece takes the other inside it

parts.note: the CIA is the US intelligence agency, a body of spies
to laud is to praise

explanation.surface: A woman agent is being commended by intelligence officers.
explanation.definitionFit: Claudia is a woman's given name, so it can stand for a female.

clue.text: Absorb new gen supplied by Arctic explorer

indicators.note: a new version of the letters is a rearranged one

parts.note: Sir James Clark Ross explored the Arctic and Antarctic

explanation.surface: Taking in fresh information provided by a polar adventurer.
explanation.definitionFit: To engross someone is to absorb their attention completely.

clue.text: Measure head

definitions.meaning: a straight-edged strip for measuring length
a head of state, one who governs

explanation.surface: Measure a head.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a measuring stick and a sovereign who leads a country.

clue.text: Unusually trite, fine Egyptian queen

indicators.note: letters arranged in an unusual way are put into a different order

explanation.surface: An Egyptian queen who is unexpectedly both dull and fine.
explanation.definitionFit: Nefertiti was the wife of Pharaoh Akhenaten, a famous queen of ancient Egypt.

clue.text: Fearful time in motion picture like Towering Inferno

indicators.note: letters set in motion are moved about into a new order

explanation.surface: A frightening time in a disaster movie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'motion picture' looks like one phrase, but 'in motion' signals the anagram and 'picture' starts the definition. The Towering Inferno is a 1974 disaster movie.
explanation.definitionFit: The Towering Inferno is a full-length cinema film, an example of a feature film.

clue.text: Lettuce's price cut

indicators.note: a cut word loses its final letter

parts.note: cost means price

explanation.surface: A greengrocer has reduced what they charge for a lettuce.
explanation.definitionFit: Cos is a variety of lettuce with long crisp leaves, also called romaine.

clue.text: Ace fare it cooked?

indicators.note: cooked food is reworked, so these letters are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: Asking whether some excellent food was made there.
explanation.definitionFit: A cafeteria is a self-service eating place where food such as this is cooked and served.

clue.text: Working not compulsory, having a lot of time?

indicators.note: one piece has the other within it

parts.note: something optional is not compulsory
an era is a long period of time

explanation.surface: Asking whether working is voluntary when one has plenty of time.
explanation.definitionFit: A machine that is working is in operation, running and functional.

clue.text: Bad taste shown during last month by old eccentric?

parts.note: in means during, as in 'in the night'
Dec is short for December, the last month of the year
rum is old British slang for odd or eccentric

explanation.surface: An odd old person behaved tastelessly over the end of the year.
explanation.definitionFit: Indecorum is improper behaviour, a lack of propriety or good taste.

clue.text: Shooting party, provided in retreat, circles courtyard

indicators.note: a retreating word goes backwards, so it is read in reverse

parts.note: if means provided, as in 'provided that'
rings are circles
a quad is a quadrangle, a college courtyard

explanation.surface: A hunting party falls back and gathers round a courtyard.
explanation.definitionFit: A firing squad is a group of soldiers detailed to shoot a condemned person, a grim shooting party.

clue.text: This may be worn as a favour

definitions.text: This may be worn as a favour

parts.words: This may be worn as a favour
parts.note: a favour is a ribbon badge worn to show support for a side or as a prize, not a kindness

explanation.walkthrough: 'favour' reads as a kindness, but it is also a ribbon or knot worn as a badge of allegiance.
explanation.definitionFit: A rosette is a circular ribbon badge, worn by supporters or awarded as a prize.

clue.text: Cause harm to planet, endlessly

indicators.note: with no end, the final letter is removed

parts.note: Mars is a planet

explanation.surface: Damaging a world without limit.
explanation.definitionFit: To mar something is to spoil or damage it.

clue.text: Actress having stitch in side, keeled over

indicators.note: something keeled over is upended, so in a down clue the letters are read from the bottom
one piece goes in the other

parts.note: a side in sport is a team
to stitch is to sew

explanation.surface: A performer collapsed with a sharp pain in her side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stitch in side' paints a cramp, but it is a sewing word placed in TEAM, all turned over by 'keeled over'. Mae West was a US film star.
explanation.definitionFit: Mae West was an American film actress famed for innuendo.

clue.text: After end of Lent, request church working party

indicators.note: the next pieces come after the first one
the end of the word is its final letter

parts.note: to ask for is to request
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Once Lent is over, a congregation is asked for volunteers.
explanation.definitionFit: A task force is a group set up to carry out a specific job, a working party.

clue.text: Earliest tree on street

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece sits on the next

parts.note: a fir is a tree

explanation.surface: The first tree planted on a road.
explanation.definitionFit: Earliest and first both mean coming before all others in time.

clue.text: Mean man conserving energy

indicators.note: one piece keeps the other within it

parts.note: a chap is a man
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A stingy man is saving electricity.
explanation.definitionFit: A mean person is tight-fisted, and cheap is used in the same sense.

clue.text: Earlier religious house, incomplete

indicators.note: the word is not finished, losing its last letter

parts.note: a priory is a monastery or convent

explanation.surface: A monastery from an earlier time, left unfinished.
explanation.definitionFit: Prior means coming before in time, earlier.

clue.text: One who has stopped working on Hebridean island

parts.note: re means on, concerning
Tiree is an island in the Inner Hebrides off western Scotland

explanation.surface: Someone who has left work and moved to a Scottish island.
explanation.definitionFit: A pensioner who has given up work for good has retired.

clue.text: English artist's age

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: The period an English painter lived in.
explanation.definitionFit: An era is a long period of history, an age.

clue.text: Native of Nazareth, former PM, losing face?

indicators.note: the face is the front, so the first letter is dropped

parts.note: Benjamin Disraeli was a British prime minister

explanation.surface: A Nazarene, once prime minister, suffers embarrassment.
explanation.definitionFit: Nazareth is a city in Israel, so someone born there is a citizen of that country.

clue.text: A well-bred fellow broker

parts.note: a gent is a gentleman

explanation.surface: A refined man who acts as a stockbroker.
explanation.definitionFit: An agent negotiates on someone's behalf, as a broker does.

clue.text: The old lady twice breaking into reform school she once attended?

indicators.note: one piece breaks into the other and sits within it

parts.note: to reform is to alter

indicators.note: the piece is used two times over

parts.note: ma is a mother, an old lady

explanation.surface: Mum, repeatedly, gets into the reform school she attended long ago.
explanation.definitionFit: Alma mater is the school or college a person used to attend.
